name: Question 14
problem: A paddling pool contains $6$ gallons of water initially. At $t=0,$ water is pumped into the pool at a constant rate of $3$ gallons per minute. After $t=2$ minutes, water starts leaking from the pool at a rate of $\sqrt{t-2}$ gallons per minute. How many gallons of water are in the pool at time $t$, for $t\ge 2?$

html:
Question 14
?

A paddling pool contains 6 gallons of water initially. At t=0, water is pumped into the pool at a constant rate of 3 gallons per minute. After t=2 minutes, water starts leaking from the pool at a rate of t−2 gallons per minute. How many gallons of water are in the pool at time t, for t≥2?

a
F(t)=6+3t−23(t−2)3/2
b
F(t)=9t−23(t−2)5/2
c
F(t)=3t−13(t−2)3/2
d
F(t)=6t+13(t−2)3/2
e
F(t)=6t+23t3/2
Submit
